# stacklet_iac_policies (Data Source)

Fetch Stacklet IaC policies from a policy source or a policy collection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch policies from an IaC policy source
data "stacklet_iac_policies" "from_source" {
  source = "example"
}

# Fetch policies in an IaC policy collection
data "stacklet_iac_policies" "from_collection" {
  collection = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `collection` (String) The name of the policy collection to fetch policies from. Exactly one of `source` or `collection` must be set.
- `source` (String) The name of the policy source to fetch policies from. Exactly one of `source` or `collection` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) The policies, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The name of the policy.
- `resources` (List of String) The resource types the policy applies to.
- `severity` (String) The severity of the policy.
- `source` (String) The name of the policy source the policy comes from.
